about.metaDescription: SciOArt — science and art for Punjab's farms. Our mission, team and review process.
about.title: About SciOArt
about.lead: SciOArt joins agricultural science with the arts of storytelling, song and play, so that good practices reach every farm in Punjab.
about.mission: To make PAU's research-based recommendations easy to find, easy to understand and easy to share — in Punjabi and English, on any phone.
about.story1: Farmers learn best from each other, from stories and from things they can touch and play. SciOArt pairs every chapter of the Package of Practices with games, songs, jingles and short lessons.
about.story2: The platform starts with Punjab and is built to grow — to California's Punjabi-speaking growers next, and to more regions and languages after that.
about.partners: SciOArt is used by Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana. Content partnerships with extension institutions in India and California are being planned.
about.review1: Text is taken from PAU's Package of Practices and research publications.
about.review2: A PAU subject expert checks every page, including numbers and Punjabi terms.
about.review3: Each page shows its source, edition and last review date.
about.review4: When PAU releases a new edition, pages are updated and the old edition is archived.
about.contact: Questions, corrections or partnership ideas? Write to us.
about.contactAsk: Have a farm question? Use Ask an Expert.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: We collect as little as possible, and only to help you.
privacy.s1: When you use Ask an Expert, we keep your question, the photo you add, your district and the contact details you give, so an expert can reply.
privacy.s2: Your language, theme, district and recent searches are saved only on your own device. You can clear them by clearing your browser data.
privacy.s3: SciOArt does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s4: Write to us to see or delete anything you sent through Ask an Expert.
